data.stale: No internet. Data as of {{time}}. Your records are being saved.
data.firstTimeTitle: Internet is needed the first time
data.firstTimeBody: Data has to reach this phone once. Connect to the internet.

saved.queued: Saved. It will be sent when there is internet.
saved.failed: Could not save on this phone. Please try again.

log.title: Daily record
log.correcting: Today is already recorded. If you change it, stock is recalculated.
log.forDate: This record is for {{date}}. Correct it and send it again.
log.noRation: This herd has no ration. Add the feed that was given.
log.herdMissingBody: Connect to the internet and refresh.
log.waitingToSend: This record is being sent. You can correct it once it arrives.
log.loggedByOther: Someone else recorded today. The zootechnician can change it.

animal.label: Animal tag
animal.noList: The animal list is not on this phone. Connect to the internet and open the Today page.

watch.subtitle: Due within {{n}} days, and overdue
watch.emptyBody: No ewe is due in the next {{n}} days, and none is overdue.

sync.title: Send queue
sync.offline: No internet. Records are kept on this phone.
sync.discardLogBody: The feed in this record will reach neither stock nor costs. If it was really given, send the record to the zootechnician instead.
sync.stuckBody: The server failed on this record several times. Records that do not depend on it carry on. Send it again, and tell your manager if it keeps failing.
sync.waitsFor: Waiting for: {{title}}. It goes out once that record is sent or deleted.
sync.serverTrouble: The server could not take this record. Trying again.
sync.emptyBody: No unsent records on this phone.
sync.others: Records of another user or farm: {{n}}. They go out when that person signs in.
sync.conflictBody: Another record is already saved for this herd and day. Which one is right?
sync.windowClosedBody: The time to correct this record has passed. Send yours to the zootechnician so that nothing is lost.
sync.serverUnknown: Internet is needed to see the saved record.
sync.keepServerBody: The saved record stays, and yours is removed from this phone.

errors.EDIT_WINDOW_CLOSED: Only the zootechnician can change this record. Send yours to them.
errors.STALE_UPDATE: The record has just changed. Look at the new one and choose again.
